title: health check endpoint returns service status
description: Verify that the /health GET endpoint returns a 200 status code with a JSON object containing the service status as a string, indicating the service is healthy.

title: essay judge endpoint validates essay quality
description: Test the /essay/judge POST endpoint by submitting essays with varying lengths, information density, and logical validity. Verify that the response includes detailed validation results for length, density, and logical validity with pass/fail status and rationale.

title: essay judge endpoint rejects essays under minimum length
description: Submit an essay with fewer than 1000 words to the /essay/judge endpoint and verify that the essay is rejected with an appropriate rationale indicating the essay is too short.

title: essay submit endpoint stores approved essays with versioning
description: Test the /essay/submit POST endpoint by submitting an approved essay and verify that it is stored in the PostgreSQL database with correct versioning and metadata.

title: essay submit endpoint enforces idempotency
description: Submit the same essay multiple times with the same idempotency_key to the /essay/submit endpoint and verify that duplicate processing is prevented and the essay is stored only once.

title: essay get endpoint retrieves latest and specific versions
description: Test the /essay/get GET endpoint by requesting the latest version and specific versions of an essay by id. Verify that the correct essay version is returned with all associated quality metrics.

title: concurrent essay submissions handled without race conditions
description: Simulate multiple concurrent requests to /essay/submit and /essay/judge endpoints and verify that the service handles concurrency correctly without failures or race conditions.

title: logical validity validation produces boolean and rationale
description: Verify that the logical validity check in the /essay/judge endpoint returns a boolean pass/fail result along with an explanatory rationale for the decision.

title: information density validation produces boolean and rationale
description: Verify that the information density check in the /essay/judge endpoint returns a boolean pass/fail result along with an explanatory rationale for the decision.

title: local development environment spins up postgres and service
description: Verify that running the make dev command successfully spins up a local PostgreSQL instance and the full service stack for development and testing.
